blurb: Guests fish with light tackle for species like trout, redfish, snook, tarpon, snapper, grouper, cobia, hogfish, and permit. Trips explore waters up to 9 miles including Anna Maria Island and Eggmont Key, with opportunities to see clear waters, sandbars, seashells, and historic ruins. The captain provides licenses, bait, tackle, ice, and a cooler, and will fillet the catch at trip end.
